blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Yorba Linda
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Yorba Linda is a semi-rural master-planned city whose two best-known attractions sit on opposite sides of Yorba Linda Boulevard several miles apart, so shuttling between the Library, the Town Center and downtown Yorba Linda is a real service.
The city's rural roads and ranch-style subdivisions have no parking and no transit, so a group of 40 or more needs a vehicle rather than carpools.
Imperial Highway and Yorba Linda Boulevard are the only arteries and they fill approaching the SR 91 and SR 57 interchanges.
The Nixon Library states it is about 20 miles from SNA and 41 miles from LAX, which makes airport transfers a substantial share of local demand.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Yorba Linda Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24.
